items.text: Service
Clear, tailored guidance before making any decision.
Not sure where to start? Start here.
Before buying, selling, renting or investing, it pays to talk. As property consultants, we tell you honestly whether it makes sense, how to do it and when, and we propose a clear roadmap.
What we help you decide

items.title: Whether
items.text: Whether it makes sense We tell you honestly whether buying, selling or waiting is the right move.

items.title: How
items.text: How to do it The right strategy for your transaction and your situation.

items.title: When
items.text: When the time is right The right moment, based on the market and your timelines.
Common situations
You might be here
[**Sell or rent?**We compare both options with numbers: sale price, expected rent, taxes and costs.Property sales and brokerage →](service:venta-estrategica)
[**Buy now or wait?**We look at the market in your area and what you can finance today.Financial advice →](service:asesoramiento-financiero)
[**I've inherited a property**What procedures are involved, what taxes to pay and what to do with it.Legal and tax advice →](service:asesoramiento-juridico-fiscal)
[**Should I renovate before selling?**What work adds value and what isn't worth it.Renovations and interior design →](service:reformas-obras)
[**I want to move house**How to coordinate selling yours and buying the new one.Property Personal Shopper →](service:personal-shopper)
[**I want to invest in property**What to buy, with what numbers and what return to actually expect.Property investment →](service:inversion-inmobiliaria)
